bounds.domain: One worker and one request; startup, READY, evaluation, termination promise settlement and return.
bounds.scope: Trusted dialect initialization precedes input delivery. Startup and evaluation keep separate deadlines, and errors cannot become valid results. Millisecond scheduling, worker capacity, arbitrary schema semantics, OS termination failure and resource accounting are outside the projection.

assumptions: Weak fairness of advance assumes compiler initialization, message delivery, host timers and termination promises eventually settle. This is no wall-clock or guaranteed OS-reaping proof.
